title: "A net for everyone": fully personalized and unsupervised neural networks trained with longitudinal data from a single patient.
summary: A per-patient Wasserstein-GAN trained on two longitudinal MRI scans maps tumor change in glioblastoma; the study reports AUC 0.87 and evaluates two datasets, with a modified RANO classification accuracy of 66%. This is a small, retrospective technical clinical result.
ai_technology: Patient-specific unsupervised Wasserstein-GAN estimates change between two MRI timepoints.
